qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.livePatch: The single-vCPU alternatives patch replaces the static LOCK prefix with a legacy DS prefix, which long mode ignores for this address.
admission.lowering: The exact live form reuses signed bit-string address selection, one restartable qword read, a final transactional qword write, and CF-only publication.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete nine-byte single instruction, non-locking DS prefix as decoded, RAX base, 0x5c0 displacement, qword width, and RDX index must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed displacement declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact alternatives-patched memory-BTR block passes its tier-one differential and rejected-write matrix.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,495 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 64, and -1, both old-bit states, complete state, resulting memory, and CF match the interpreter.
verification.faultCoverage: A forced final-write rejection preserves complete block-entry state and memory after exactly one write attempt.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a changed displacement both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The exact 13,268-hit alternatives-patched BTR site is absent from the candidate's capped live negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 116,540 of 218,684 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
